newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian cement firm Enfidha on bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian cement firm Enfidha on bond issue.

text.p: Tunisian cement firm Les Ciments d'Enfidha on Wednesday said it has launched a five-year bond issue worth 20 million dinars at a nine percent coupon rate.
It said the paper, which matures on June 23, 2002, would be issued in units worth 100 dinars each.
The issue is garanteed by Banque Nationale Agricole, Societe Tunisienne de Banque, Banque de l'Habitat, Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie and Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie.

The state-controlled firm started production in 1983 with a capacity of 1.2 million tonnes of cement and 1.0 million tonnes of clinker in its plant located in the region of Enfidha, 70 kilometres (43 miles) south of Tunis. It made a 46.833 million dinars turnover in 1995. ($=1.0957 dinar)
